name: Build Godot 3.6.3 Android Editor

on:
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  build-android-editor:
    name: Build Android editor (ARM64)
    runs-on: ubuntu-22.04
    timeout-minutes: 180

    steps:
      - name: Checkout source
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Java
        uses: actions/setup-java@v5
        with:
          distribution: temurin
          java-version: '17'

      - name: Set up Android SDK tools
        uses: android-actions/setup-android@v4
        with:
          accept-android-sdk-licenses: false
          log-accepted-android-sdk-licenses: false
          packages: ''

      - name: Accept Android SDK licenses and install required packages
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          yes | sdkmanager --licenses >/dev/null
          sdkmanager \
            "platform-tools" \
            "platforms;android-32" \
            "build-tools;32.0.0" \
            "ndk;23.2.8568313"

      - name: Install build dependencies
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y \
            build-essential \
            pkg-config \
            python3 \
            python3-pip \
            yasm \
            libx11-dev \
            libxcursor-dev \
            libxinerama-dev \
            libxi-dev \
            libxrandr-dev \
            libxrender-dev \
            libgl1-mesa-dev \
            libglu1-mesa-dev \
            libasound2-dev \
            libpulse-dev \
            libudev-dev
          python3 -m pip install --user scons
          echo "$HOME/.local/bin" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"

      - name: Configure Android environment
        run: |
          echo "ANDROID_HOME=$ANDROID_HOME" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          echo "ANDROID_SDK_ROOT=$ANDROID_HOME" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          echo "ANDROID_NDK_ROOT=$ANDROID_HOME/ndk/23.2.8568313" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          echo "ANDROID_NDK_HOME=$ANDROID_HOME/ndk/23.2.8568313" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"

      - name: Build Godot 3.6.3 Android editor
        run: |
          scons platform=android target=release_debug tools=yes arch=arm64 android_arch=arm64 -j2

      - name: Upload build outputs
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: godot-3.6.3-android-arm64-editor
          path: |
            bin/*android*arm64*
            bin/*.apk
          if-no-files-found: warn
          retention-days: 7
